enumeration_method: All actual kernel constants with getModuleIdxFor?=none; independently cross-checked against SMap import-stage difference and local stage2; no namespace/public filtering

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.Cluster
owned.definition_body: fun z => {L | ∃ σ, StrictMono σ ∧ Tendsto (fun j => z (σ j)) atTop (𝓝 L)}

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.WeakCell
owned.definition_body:
fun c n =>
  1 ≤ Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.height c n ∧
    1 ≤ Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.phaseFloor c n ∧
      ↑(Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.phaseFloor c n) ≤ Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.height c n ∧
        Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.height c n < Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.upperHeight c n ∧
          Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.upperHeight c n =
              Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.height c n + Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.delta c n ∧
            0 < Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.delta c n ∧ Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.delta c n ≤ 1

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.belowCubeIndex
owned.definition_body: fun k => k ^ 3 - 1

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.cubeIndex
owned.definition_body: fun k => k ^ 3

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.cutoff
owned.definition_body: fun c => max 1 ⌈1 / c ^ 3⌉₊

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.delta
owned.definition_body: fun c n => Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.upperHeight c n - Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.height c n

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.downIndex
owned.definition_body: fun c k => ⌈Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.target c 0 k⌉₊ - 1

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.exponent
owned.definition_body: fun c n => Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.q c * Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.delta c n

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.factor
owned.definition_body: fun c n => Real.exp (Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.exponent c n)

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.height
owned.definition_body: fun c n => c * Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.root n

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.nearestIndex
owned.definition_body: fun c α k => ⌊Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.target c α k + 1 / 2⌋₊

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.phaseFloor
owned.definition_body: fun c n => ⌊Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.height c n⌋₊

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.phaseIndex
owned.definition_body:
fun c d k =>
  if d = 0 then Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.downIndex c k
  else
    if d = 1 then Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.upIndex c k
    else Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.nearestIndex c (1 - d) k

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.q
owned.definition_body: fun c => Real.pi ^ 2 / (4 * c ^ 3)

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.root
owned.definition_body: fun n => (↑n).rpow (1 / 3)

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.target
owned.definition_body: fun c β k => ((↑k + β) / c) ^ 3

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.upIndex
owned.definition_body: fun c k => ⌈Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.target c 0 k⌉₊

owned.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.upperHeight
owned.definition_body: fun c n => ↑(Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.phaseFloor c n) + 1

owned.name: _private.Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.0.Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.aux_DownStable
owned.definition_body:
fun c k =>
  2 ≤ k ∧
    ↑k - 1 < Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.height c (Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.downIndex c k) ∧
      Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.height c (Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.downIndex c k) < ↑k ∧
        Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.phaseFloor c (Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.downIndex c k) = k - 1

owned.name: _private.Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.0.Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.aux_InternalStable
owned.definition_body:
fun c α k =>
  ↑k < Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.height c (Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.nearestIndex c α k) ∧
    Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.height c (Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.nearestIndex c α k) < ↑k + 1 ∧
      Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.phaseFloor c (Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.nearestIndex c α k) = k

owned.name: _private.Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.0.Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.aux_TailResult
owned.definition_body:
fun c w d P =>
  ∃ K,
    2 ≤ K ∧
      (StrictMono fun j => w (j + K)) ∧
        (∀ (j : ℕ), Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.cutoff c ≤ w (j + K)) ∧
          (∀ (j : ℕ), P (j + K)) ∧
            Tendsto (fun j => Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.delta c (w (j + K))) atTop (𝓝 d) ∧
              Tendsto (fun j => Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.exponent c (w (j + K))) atTop
                  (𝓝 (Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.q c * d)) ∧
                Tendsto (fun j => Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.factor c (w (j + K))) atTop
                  (𝓝 (Real.exp (Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.q c * d)))

owned.name: _private.Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.0.Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.aux_UpStable
owned.definition_body:
fun c k =>
  1 ≤ k ∧
    ↑k ≤ Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.height c (Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.upIndex c k) ∧
      Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.height c (Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.upIndex c k) < ↑k + 1 ∧
        Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.phaseFloor c (Shao.OQ4.RademacherCriticalPhase.upIndex c k) = k
